proposals.evidence: Turner gives European Romani tato 'hot' under taptá, with Pali/Prakrit tatta. The source explicitly prints Zargari tatho for tatto and describes aspiration in place of gemination (p. 127 §2.3.8). Its source-defined tatto variant is already an installed variant, not another assignment row. Original PDF, glyph-decoded source audit and imported key checked; no transcription or identity change.

proposals.evidence: Turner gives European Romani gudlo/gullo/gulo 'sweet' as derivatives of guḍá² 'molasses'. The source prints Zargari gudlo/guldo with 'sugar; candy, sweet' and explicitly calls this liquid metathesis (p. 129 §2.3.24). The installed guldo variant already points to gudlo; the single reviewed record retains all source senses. Original PDF, glyph-decoded source audit and imported key checked; no transcription or identity change.
